changes: Added additional information on texture size for shadow map settings to help users assess what shadow map to use.
Added setting for lens flare to be defaulted to on.
Fixed a few snapping bugs
added new bloom effects with spokes and color shift
more options in flare debug to customize sun bloom and flare effects
[WIP] continues for some flare occlusion effects and improved bloom/blur
Editing now occurs in another dimension.
Added special handling for computers with very low VRAM. Now shadow map will override its default sizing for this.
Changed TestSystem to be EarthOnly, but include some earth textures and the Apollo CSM to make it more useful.
Added full list of all encounters to FlightPlan UI. Previously only showed closest approach info.
Added checkbox to transfer planner to show a marker on the parent/source body orbit of the best Hohmann alignment time.

Added checkbox to transfer planner to override the default behavior of showing the closest approach marker information, if selected will show the closest approach info for the selected target body (if an approach exists), if one doesn't it will fall back to the default behavior.
Fixed shadow map was being overwritten due to memory issues.
Added basic install script file to allow installer to be generated automatically to assist with deployment. Inno used for now, but needs to be replaced with something better.
Fixed issue with installer config file was in incorrect place.
Added missing ISS config file.
Fixed minor bug with outputting iss config file for installer generation.
Added uninstall prompt if deleting settings and saves as well.
Fixed local install was default, not admin install is prompted as default.
Add upscaling to godrays and accumulate multiple frames (using reprojection) to improve performance. Godrays performance cost is now down from ~4 ms to ~0.65 ms on 2080 super at 1440p.
Added a Reset Game Settings Option to the Game Settings Menu
must reset and then apply
flare and bloom effects are appropriately culled and take on the appearance of 'through' atmosphere or not
blur option added to debug and new default settings
moved bloom/flare effects after atmospherics
[WIP] eclipse flare effects
improvement pass for atmospheric bloom
eclipsed effects on flares

Added the ability for vehicles to collide with and rest on planetary surfaces. This is a very simple version to start which treats the vehicle as an analytic sphere and only collides directly in the radial direction. It also does not take the surface normal into account at the moment.
Added a symplectic Euler integrator which we use to resolve collision along with a scheme of sequential impulses.

Major rework to vehicle state and update logic. We can now choose multiple different update methods within a single frame - for example, taking a Kepler step to the edge of the atmosphere, integrating with velocity Verlet to the surface, and resolving and impact with symplectic Euler.

Added a minimum target framerate to prevent the FPS "death spiral" when there is too much work to get done in a single frame, so the target frame time increases exponentially each time. We will now scale back the time compression rate to try and fit within a reasonable frame rate.
Added a new Simulation tab to the game settings for various physics parameters.
Adjusted celestial creation to be a full preorder traversal, meaning each celestial is fully baked before its children are instantiated.
Lowered the minimum camera altitude to 0.5 meters.
Added some float3 extension methods and renamed DoubleVectorEx to Double3Ex.
Added a physics debug window.
Changed the patched conics parent impact detector to use a direct calculation rather than a bisect search.
Fixed attitude snapping using the wrong coordinate frame rates.
Fixed debug thruster arrows being drawn in the wrong location.
Added LC-39A to Earth landmarks.
more debug options added
inner glow size
horizontal spoke modifier
adaptive scaling of inner glow based on occlusion
Added a new navball mode, SURF. This mode is an East-North-Up frame, which is useful for surface navigation or when you don't have enough velocity to generate a solid orbital direction.
Renamed existing navball buttons to STAR, ORBT, VEL, and BURN.
Added new Surface, Parent, and Chase camera modes. Renamed existing modes to Orbit, Poles, and Stars.
The camera now auto-transitions between Surface, Orbit, and Parent modes when following a Vehicle.
Switched alerts to use player time instead of sim time.
fixed bug leaning on occlusion color that caused sunrise/sunset to miss half its rise/set
added an adaptive inner glow size based on occlusion color and a minimum transmittance
this is designed to give a diffuse/broader bloom in atmosphere during rise/set
artistically replicates how the sun "grows in size" against a horizon
debug option for adaptive inner glow size to tailor to taste
Restructured CommandBufferPool to use a handle approach rather than relying on the external code to properly manage the lifetime of command buffers and semaphores
